arxiv-1802-10555.title: Continuity of Functional Transducers: A Profinite Study of Rational Functions
arxiv-1802-10555.creator: Michaël Cadilhac \rsuper a, Olivier Carton \rsuper b, Charles Paperman \rsuper c
arxiv-1802-10555.description: Abstract . A word-to-word function is continuous for a class of languages 𝒱 \mathcal{V} if its inverse maps 𝒱 \mathcal{V} _languages to 𝒱 \mathcal{V} . This notion provides a basis for an algebraic study of transducers, and was integral to the characterization of the sequential transducers computable in some circuit complexity classes.

arxiv-2012-09353.title: The COVID-19 Infodemic: Twitter versus Facebook
arxiv-2012-09353.creator: Kai-Cheng Yang, Francesco Pierri, Pik-Mai Hui, David Axelrod, Christopher Torres-Lugo, John Bryden, Filippo Menczer
arxiv-2012-09353.description: Abstract The global spread of the novel coronavirus is affected by the spread of related misinformation — the so-called COVID-19 Infodemic — that makes populations more vulnerable to the disease through resistance to mitigation efforts. Here we analyze the prevalence and diffusion of links to low-credibility content about the pandemic across two major social media platforms, Twitter and Facebook.

arxiv-2101-10475.title: Neutrino non-standard interactions meet precision measurements of 𝑵 𝐞𝐟𝐟 N_{\rm eff} arXiv: 2101.10475
arxiv-2101-10475.creator: Yong Du, Jiang-Hao Yu
arxiv-2101-10475.description: Abstract The number of relativistic species, N eff N_{\rm eff} , has been precisely calculated in the standard model, and would be measured to the percent level by CMB-S4 in future. Neutral-current non-standard interactions would affect neutrino decoupling in the early Universe, thus modifying N eff N_{\rm eff} .

arxiv-2104-04422.title: Evaluating participants’ experience of extended interaction with cutting-edge physics research through the PRiSE ‘research in schools’ programme
arxiv-2104-04422.creator: Martin O. Archer, Jennifer DeWitt, Charlotte Thorley, Olivia Keenan
arxiv-2104-04422.description: Abstract Physics in schools is distinctly different from, and struggles to capture the excitement of, university research-level work. Initiatives where students engage in independent research linked to cutting-edge physics within their school over several months might help mitigate this, potentially facilitating the uptake of science in higher education. However, how such initiatives are best supported remains unclear and understudied.

arxiv-2209-04455.title: A measurement of circumgalactic gas around nearby galaxies using fast radio bursts 2015 A measurement of circumgalactic gas around nearby galaxies using fast radio bursts – A
arxiv-2209-04455.creator: Xiaohan Wu, Matthew McQuinn
arxiv-2209-04455.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xiaohan Wu, Matthew McQuinn. The distribution of gas in the circumgalactic medium (CGM) of galaxies of all types is poorly constrained. Foreground CGMs contribute an extra amount to the dispersion measure (DM) of fast radio bursts (FRB). We measure this DM excess for the CGMs of 10 11 − 10 13 ​ M ⊙ 10^{11}-10^{13}\ M_{\odot} halos using the CHIME/FRB first data release, a halo mass range that is challenging to probe in any other way.

arxiv-2409-16443.title: Asymptotic Lower Bounds for the Feedback Arc Set Problem in Random Graphs
arxiv-2409-16443.creator: Harvey Diamond, Mark Kon, Louise Raphael
arxiv-2409-16443.description: Abstract Given a directed graph, the Minimal Feedback Arc Set (FAS) problem asks for a minimal set of arcs in a directed graph, which, when removed, results in an acyclic graph. Equivalently, the FAS problem asks to find an ordering of the vertices that minimizes the number of feedback arcs.

arxiv-2412-14184.title: Evolution of Hubble parameter from Pantheon+ data and comparison of cosmological models using cosmic chronometers
arxiv-2412-14184.creator: Ardra Edathandel Sasi, Moncy Vilavinal John
arxiv-2412-14184.description: Abstract The evolution of the Hubble parameter H ⁡ ( z ) H(z) with redshift z z is estimated from the Pantheon+ data of Type Ia supernovae, for the Λ \Lambda CDM model and the three special cases of the eternal coasting (EC) cosmological model with three different spatial geometries.

arxiv-2505-08243.title: Training Strategies for Efficient Embodied Reasoning
arxiv-2505-08243.creator: William Chen, Suneel Belkhale, Suvir Mirchandani, Oier Mees, Danny Driess, Karl Pertsch, Sergey Levine
arxiv-2505-08243.description: Abstract Robot chain-of-thought reasoning (CoT) – wherein a model predicts helpful intermediate representations before choosing actions – provides an effective method for improving the generalization and performance of robot policies, especially vision-language-action models (VLAs). While such approaches have been shown to improve performance and generalization, they suffer from core limitations, like needing specialized robot reasoning data and slow inference speeds.

arxiv-2505-12859.title: Re-identification of De-identified Documents with Autoregressive Infilling
arxiv-2505-12859.creator: Lucas Georges Gabriel Charpentier, Pierre Lison
arxiv-2505-12859.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Lucas Georges Gabriel Charpentier, Pierre Lison. Documents revealing sensitive information about individuals must typically be de-identified. This de-identification is often done by masking all mentions of personally identifiable information (PII), thereby making it more difficult to uncover the identity of the person(s) in question. To investigate the robustness of de-identification methods, we present a novel, RAG-inspired approach that attempts the reverse process of re-identification based on a database of documents representing background knowledge.

arxiv-2507-09471.title: CKAA: Cross-subspace Knowledge Alignment and Aggregation for Robust Continual Learning
arxiv-2507-09471.creator: Lingfeng He, De Cheng, Zhiheng Ma, Huaijie Wang, Dingwen Zhang, Nannan Wang, Xinbo Gao
arxiv-2507-09471.description: Abstract Continual Learning (CL) empowers AI models to continuously learn from sequential task streams. Recently, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT)-based CL methods have garnered increasing attention due to their superior performance. They typically allocate a unique sub-module for learning each task, with a task recognizer to select the appropriate sub-modules for testing images.

pmc-10618284.title: A genome-scale metabolic model of parasitic whipworm
pmc-10618284.creator: Ömer F. Bay, Kelly S. Hayes, Jean-Marc Schwartz, Richard K. Grencis, Ian S. Roberts
pmc-10618284.description: Genome-scale metabolic models are widely used to enhance our understanding of metabolic features of organisms, host-pathogen interactions and to identify therapeutics for diseases. Here we present iTMU798, the genome-scale metabolic model of the mouse whipworm Trichuris muris. The model demonstrates the metabolic features of T. muris and allows the prediction of metabolic steps essential for its survival.

pmc-10705029.title: Haitian State Hospital Orthopedic Grand Rounds Series: A Virtual Curriculum to Address Global Surgery Needs
pmc-10705029.creator: Lindsay Hock, Melissa Zahl, Pierre-Marie Woolley, Christina Barau Dejean, Christian A Pean, Ronald Israelski
pmc-10705029.description: Background:Orthopedic Relief Services International (ORSI), in partnership with the Foundation for Orthopedic Trauma and the department of Orthopedic Surgery of La Paix University Hospital in Haiti, has developed a year-round Orthopedic Grand Round series. This series is moderated by Haitian faculty, features presentations by American orthopedic surgeons, and is broadcast to major state hospitals in Haiti for residents and attendings.

pmc-12604522.title: Prospective Evaluation of a Novel Multifocal Toric Daily Disposable Contact Lens in Presbyopic Adults with Astigmatism
pmc-12604522.creator: Ross Franklin, Jessica Lin Cannon-Hill, Ryan Sherrill, Giovanna E Olivares
pmc-12604522.description: PurposeTo evaluate the clinical performance of a novel multifocal toric contact lens design combining a pupil-optimized multifocal design with a blink stabilized toric design featuring a single cylinder power and a choice of 3 add powers in a group of presbyopic patients with low to moderate astigmatism.

pmc-12638693.title: Mixed Erdheim–Chester disease with thoraco-abdominal involvement
pmc-12638693.creator: Thomas Saliba, David Rotzinger, Laura Haefliger, Guillaume Fahrni
pmc-12638693.description: Erdheim–Chester disease (ECD) is a rare non-Langerhans cell histiocytosis. Mixed ECD–Langerhans cell histiocytosis (LCH) is uncommon, with fewer than 200 cases reported. Diagnosis is challenging and relies on clinical, radiological, and histopathological correlation. We present the case of a 61-year-old man with night sweats, weight loss, and recently diagnosed type 2 diabetes.

pmc-12967731.title: Experiences of Patients, Family Members and Nurses in Outpatient Cancer Care: A Multi‐Method Qualitative Study
pmc-12967731.creator: Nerea Azcárate‐Cenoz, Cristina Alfaro‐Díaz, Ana Ojer Perea, María Ángeles Soteras Ramírez, Cristina Arellano Gil, Patricia Beorlegui Murillo, Nuria Esandi
pmc-12967731.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionCancer significantly impacts patients and their families, disrupting their emotional, relational, and organisational dynamics. Outpatient oncology nurses play a pivotal role in addressing the complex and evolving needs of patients with cancer and their families. Including the perspectives of nurses, family members, and patients within this care setting may inform the development of appropriate care services responsive to their real needs.

pmc-13025348.title: Knowledge, Attitude, and Practice of Emergency Department Healthcare Professionals Towards Traumatic Dental Injuries Across Public Hospitals in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
pmc-13025348.creator: Haifa AlAmro, Asma Alshahrani, Kiran Iyer, Latifah Almashabi, Hala Alanazi, Arwa Alshahrani, Nouf Alrawaf
pmc-13025348.description: Background/Objectives: Emergency department healthcare professionals are often the first to provide treatment, yet studies indicate limited knowledge in Traumatic Dental Injuries (TDIs) management among these providers. While research on TDI management in emergency departments exists globally, recent data from Saudi Arabia is lacking.

pmc-13133115.title: Optimized parameter estimation of solar PV models using an improved red-tailed hawk algorithm
pmc-13133115.creator: Pankaj Sharma, Asmita Ajay Rathod, Shubhi Shukla, Arun Choudhary, Saravanakumar Raju, Balaji Subramanian
pmc-13133115.description: This work introduces a metaheuristic (MH) optimization method, which is inspired by the red-tailed hawks’ predatory behavior is Improved Red-tailed Hawk (IRTHA) Algorithm. The algorithm uses a dynamic adjustment method which uses the combined effect of nonlinear decay and chaotic mapping to enhance the convergence efficacy and accuracy of outcomes.

pmc-13243456.title: Adipocyte small extracellular vesicle-derived microRNA-30a-3p exacerbates hepatic steatosis in high fat diet-fed male mice
pmc-13243456.creator: Tian Zhang, Longkun Hu, Diao Chen, Yongxin Chen, Fei Zhou, Ruohan Lou, Yuxia Zhou, Yuanyuan Wang, Mingjun Shi, Ke-Gang Linghu, Ligen Lin, Bing Guo
pmc-13243456.description: Adipose tissue dysfunction drives hepatic lipid overload in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), yet the involvement of adipose tissue-derived small extracellular vesicles (sEVs) remains unclear. Herein, we showed that transplanting adipose tissue from high‑fat diet (HFD)-fed male mice exacerbated insulin resistance and hepatic steatosis in lean recipients.
